card.name: The word physician and what precedes it
card.fires_on: The start of the word physician (phys-) or the space before it, mostly in names of organizations, documents and URLs. It also fires on small words like the, of, by that come just before institution or physician terms.

modes.label: Start of physician
modes.description: The first piece of the word physician or physicians, often in URLs or hyphenated phrases.

modes.label: Physician after a noun
modes.description: The word physician right after a noun in a title or record name.
